waypoints.name: Bedal Creek Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From Darrington, drive the Mountain Loop Highway south about 17 miles and turn left onto FR 4096, about a mile past Bedal Campground. Climb the steep, narrow road about 2 miles to its end at roughly 2,800 ft; high clearance is recommended. The road is not plowed, so in a normal winter skinning starts well below the trailhead. A Northwest Forest Pass is required to park.

waypoints.name: Sloan Peak summit
waypoints.directions: Follow Bedal Creek Trail #705 up the Bedal Creek valley to the meadow at about 5,000 ft beneath the west face, normally a 4 to 5 hour skin in winter. Climb the spur ridge west of the peak to about 5,700 ft, leave skis, and take the obvious ice line on the right side of the face, a WI4 curtain then fat WI3 in the main gully, to the upper snowfields and up them to the summit.
